RegistrationInfo.Description: W365 thin client (SCRIPT-FREE): log off the local IoT session when exiting Modern Standby (Kernel-Power 507) ONLY if the exit Reason is Lid (code 15) or Power Button (code 1) AND the standby lasted longer than 120 seconds (EventData DurationInUs > 120000000 microseconds - the floor is evaluated inside the trigger query, no script). Reason codes are the community-decoded values and MUST be verified against the pilot device's own event XML before fleet use (see VERIFY.md).

EventTrigger.Subscription: <QueryList><Query Id="0" Path="System"><Select Path="System">*[System[Provider[@Name='Microsoft-Windows-Kernel-Power'] and (EventID=507)] and EventData[(Data[@Name='Reason']=15 or Data[@Name='Reason']=1) and Data[@Name='DurationInUs']>120000000]]</Select></Query></QueryList>
